title: Mau Mau Uprising
description:
From 1952 to 1960, the **Mau Mau Uprising** was a rebellion against British colonial rule in Kenya.

The movement was primarily composed of Kikuyu people fighting for land and freedom. The British response included mass detention and harsh counter-insurgency measures.

The uprising was a crucial step toward Kenyan independence, which was achieved in 1963.
